title: Remote Control of Television Equipment
scope: of the ESbus documentation. The presentation layer (6) contains the virtual machine, which responds to defined data — the control language in a defined manner regardless of the characteristics of the physical machine used at the applications level. Each type of virtual machine utilizes a distinct dialect within the overall control language. Common and virtual machine (type specific) messages are presentation layer constructs. The session layer (5) connects two presentation entities and controls communications between them.
